title: Temple of Heaven Opens at 6:30 — the Halls Wait Till 8 | China Travel Expert
description:
Timing is everything at Beijing's Temple of Heaven.

The park grounds (Tiantan Park) open early: 6:00 am in peak season (1 Apr–31 Oct) and 6:30 am in the low season (1 Nov–31 Mar) — so from today, it's the 6:30 winter start.

But the historic buildings — the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the Imperial Vault of Heaven and the Circular Mound Altar — don't open until 8:00 am, and they're closed on Mondays except on public holidays. So an early-morning visitor gets a near-empty park a good 90 minutes before the paid halls open.

🧭 Expert Tip: arrive right at opening to walk the long cypress avenue and the round Hall before the tour groups arrive; buy the through-ticket if you want the halls, not just the park.

天坛公园早晨开放（旺季 6:00，淡季从 11 月 1 日起 6:30），但祉年殿等古建筑 8:00 才开，周一除节假日外闭馆。
